metrics.label: Catalogued space objects
metrics.definition: Approximate number of objects regularly tracked by space surveillance networks and maintained in their catalogue.
metrics.uncertainty_note: ESA headline summary says about 47,280. The detailed object-by-orbit table on the same page totals 47,290; discrepancy retained and not silently reconciled.

metrics.label: Detailed catalogue table total
metrics.definition: Sum shown in ESA's detailed table of orbiting objects per object type and orbital regime.
metrics.uncertainty_note: Differs by 10 from the portal headline summary (47,280). Kept as a separate source-reported figure pending clarification.

metrics.label: Modelled objects larger than 10 cm
metrics.definition: Estimated population of space objects greater than 10 cm, including approximately 11,300 active payloads.
metrics.uncertainty_note: Statistical population estimate, not a catalogue count.

metrics.label: Modelled debris greater than 1 cm to 10 cm
metrics.definition: Approximate estimated debris population greater than 1 cm and up to 10 cm.
metrics.uncertainty_note: Rounded statistical estimate, not an individually tracked inventory.

metrics.label: Modelled debris greater than 1 mm to 1 cm
metrics.definition: Approximate estimated debris population greater than 1 mm and up to 1 cm.
metrics.uncertainty_note: Rounded statistical estimate, not an individually tracked inventory.

metrics.label: Fragmentation events
metrics.definition: Cumulative ESA headline count of break-ups, explosions, collisions or anomalous events resulting in fragmentation.
metrics.uncertainty_note: ESA reports more than 660; 660 is a lower-bound display value, not an exact count.
